    # Mirror each row left-to-right, then append the original row.
    # Stack three copies vertically, with the first and third flipped top-to-bottom.
    mirrored = [list(reversed(row)) + list(row) for row in grid]
    flipped = list(reversed(mirrored))
    return flipped + mirrored + flipped
'''
